company.name: Kubecost
company.shortDescription: Kubecost provides real-time cost visibility and insights for teams using Kubernetes.
company.description: Kubecost is a developer of a cost monitoring platform to help companies manage their Kubernetes resources and costs. Its platform also provides direct integrations with the Kubernetes API and cloud billing APIs, cost allocations for all key Kubernetes concepts, dynamic recommendations for optimizing cloud spend, and infrastructure assessment services helping clients to reduce spending and prevent resource-based outages.

productsAndServices.description: A Kubernetes cost monitoring and optimization platform deployed in a customer’s infrastructure to allocate spend, analyze usage, manage budgets, and identify resource-efficiency improvements.
productsAndServices.name: Kubecost Self-Hosted

productsAndServices.description: A fully managed, multi-tenant SaaS service for monitoring and optimizing Kubernetes and cloud spending, with a local Kubecost Agent collecting data from connected clusters.
productsAndServices.name: Kubecost Cloud

productsAndServices.description: An open-source Kubernetes cost allocation tool for measuring resource consumption and attributing cluster costs to workloads, teams, namespaces, and other Kubernetes entities.
productsAndServices.name: OpenCost

productsAndServices.description: Implementation, onboarding, training, technical support, and advisory services for organizations deploying and operating Kubecost at enterprise scale.
productsAndServices.name: Kubecost Enterprise Support and Professional Services

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $25,000,000, or 82.78% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,798,390 to $127,282,771, a 16.32x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
